title: Epistemic Injustice in Generative AI
findings: Generative AI models were found to perpetuate state-sponsored testimonial injustice by creating propaganda that denies the 'Islamophobic religious suppression' of Uyghurs (e.g., ChatGPT). They can also be adversarially prompted to generate hateful propaganda, including 'antisemitic' and 'Islamophobic' images (e.g., Bing Image Creator/DALLE-3).
